card.name: Digits just before an x or ×
card.fires_on: A digit or word start where the next piece is likely to be an x or ×, such as the first digit in strength numbers or a number before 'x' in dimensions.

modes.label: Strength digit
modes.description: First digit of an inhaler strength like 100/25 mcg after the product name.

modes.label: Size or count number
modes.description: A digit in a dimension or measurement, often followed by x or mL.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward x-starting text, and away from the × sign and capital X forms.
card.plain: It fires on numbers or word starts where an 'x' is expected to come next, as in sizes like 8.7 x 13.8.
